description: MCP tool surface this learning kit exposes. All names and params are fabricated for teaching; no live server, no credentials, no real private paths.

tools.name: hash_lock_check
tools.description: Recompute sha256 of every example fixture from bytes and compare to its .sha256 sidecar. Returns checked, matched, ok.

overrides.description: in-memory byte substitutions for the negative control; never written to disk

tools.name: tamper_falsifier
tools.description: Flip one byte of the first fixture IN MEMORY and confirm hash_lock_check returns ok=false. Proves the gate can go red.
